metadata.commit_subject: Placement: the schematic's layout notes become proximity rows
metadata.method: Read-only documentation and implementation inspection plus static AST/path/symbol validation. No native design, routing, installation, CLI help, benchmark or test workload executed by research agent.

capabilities.entrypoints: py_tools/check_groups.py BOARD --groups groups.json; py_placer/place_simple.py BOARD OUT --groups groups.json --intent intent.json
capabilities.semantics: Group schema carries name, role, refs, anchor, why, side, edge, near/apart and template candidates. Coverage reports missing/duplicate membership; double membership is refused by placement. High-fanout/common rails are excluded from signal-cohesion inference.
capabilities.limitations: A human/agent must supply functional meaning from the circuit. Proximity followers and template members can be folded into anchor groups; reconcile that change with required membership. A shared GND net is not proof that circuits form one block.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q2,Q6: author separate power, MCU, interface, analog blocks sharing GND; duplicate and omit a reference as negatives.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Every footprint exactly once or explicit fixed/shared role; input-to-final membership report; rail exclusion; no duplicate silently accepted.

capabilities.entrypoints: py_tools/board_context.py BOARD --md; route.py --list-groups --group-by SOURCES; check_floorplan.py --emit-intent intent.json
capabilities.semantics: Read native KiCad groups, sheet paths, net prefixes and decap ownership; board_context adds schematic sheet geometry, notes and pin/net relationships.
capabilities.limitations: Derived groups and schematic drawn proximity are evidence for authored intent, not guaranteed electrical architecture. Schematic discovery errors are reported; no circuit synthesis occurs.
capabilities.exercise: Q2: two sheet instances plus shared power; compare authored groups with discovered references and paths.
capabilities.required_output_checks: No collision between repeated sheet reference identities; no lost part; recorded derivation and override sources.

capabilities.entrypoints: board_context.py BOARD --schematic ROOT.kicad_sch --md; intent proximity[] consumed by place_simple.py
capabilities.semantics: Latest commit extracts candidate proximity rows from native schematic layout-note clauses; pin ownership uses named or unambiguous nearby parts, verifies net relationships, leaves max_mm null.
capabilities.limitations: This is candidate extraction. Agent skill proposes 2 mm pin-local and 5 mm part-local defaults when no owner limit exists; these are agent-selected defaults, never owner requirements. Stale notes are rejected; unnamed subjects require judgment.
capabilities.exercise: Q2: correct, stale-after-renumbering and ambiguous notes; declare actual limits then place.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Correct pad/net identities, stale exclusion, limit provenance, final saved pin-edge distances; null limits must not pass as enforced.

capabilities.entrypoints: place_simple.py BOARD OUT --groups groups.json --intent intent.json --seeds 6 --clustered-seeds 6 --judge 6 --jobs 1
capabilities.semantics: Anneals one objective with Manhattan signal MST, weaker power/ground wire terms, crossings, pin claims, decap sites, group cohesion, near/apart/edge hints, fanout halo, foreign-pad crossing and congestion. Scattered, clustered and optional anchored starts; part/group moves carry claimed satellites.
capabilities.limitations: Heuristic optimizer, no global optimum or routability guarantee. Scalar score cannot replace required final checks. Switch-loop area/inductance and return-path terms are not optimized.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q2: identical groups, seeds and move budgets on KRT and agent-ee.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Per-seed cost breakdown, legality, block positions, required pin limits, actual final routing completion and runtime; retain all attempted seeds.

capabilities.feature: Fixed poses, locks and mechanical anchors
capabilities.entrypoints: intent fixed_poses[], must_lock; place_pose.py BOARD OUT set REF X Y --rot R --intent intent.json
capabilities.semantics: Native locked parts stay fixed. Declared poses are seated/held and checked; explicit fixed mechanical placement participates in legality.
capabilities.limitations: A fixed pose can conflict with another declaration. Error/waiver policies must be preserved. Fixed poses are not an enclosure or 3D collision solver.
capabilities.exercise: Q6: fixed connector and mounting holes, overlapping contradictory anchors, rotated anchor.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Final x/y/rotation/side/lock vs authored coordinates and tolerances; reject contradictory constraints, independently grade holes/outline.

capabilities.entrypoints: groups.side / intent blocks and side declarations applied by place_simple.py
capabilities.semantics: Declared side claims are reconciled; conflicting side claims refuse placement. Faces are applied before annealing. Opposite-side bodies may overlap while through-hole barriers remain.
capabilities.limitations: place_simple does not jointly search arbitrary top/bottom assignments: an outer strategy must enumerate permitted choices and regrade. The edge_connector_side check is fixed WARN (cannot be raised to error there), so required side correctness needs an independent gate. No height/enclosure volume optimization was identified in placement source.
capabilities.exercise: Q2,Q6: permitted back decap under front IC, forbidden-side connector and back part intersecting a through-hole field.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Final side matches permissions; mirrored pad transformations correct; cross-board adjacency measured; drilling/hardware collisions rejected.

capabilities.entrypoints: intent edge_connectors[]; place_simple edge seating; check_floorplan.py BOARD --intent intent.json
capabilities.semantics: Seat probe searches edge positions and rotations using grader constraints. Edge reach is copper-edge clearance. For edge_receptacle or mount_mode=edge_mount, seat rectangle uses drawn fab/silk body; otherwise courtyard. At corners reached edges resolve using mating face, overhang, then parallel body span and gap.
capabilities.limitations: Nearest bbox edge alone is not equivalent. No universal maximum setback is implied. Failed seating can leave a movable part with diagnostics. Agent-ee parent is repairing seat-rectangle currency and corner identity; mating-face capture and connector rotation remain explicit evidence gaps.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q6: asymmetric courtyard/body, both corner edges reached, edge-mount overhang, wrong mating face and obstructed plug insertion.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Final native body/seat/pads and mating region; declared edge identity, along-edge position, allowed setback/overhang, access keepout; no invented constraints.

capabilities.entrypoints: intent keepouts/zones/exclusive zones; place_simple.py; place_pose.py --strict-legal
capabilities.semantics: Exact final legality uses same-side courtyards, opposite-side through-hole clusters, pads/custom copper, NPTH and real Edge.Cuts including curves/cutouts. Missing courtyards fall back to drawn body plus pads. Annealed soft overlap is followed by reseating/retry/shove.
capabilities.limitations: No general 3D height/collision analysis. Outline-only containers have exceptions; locked shields can remain solid obstacles. Legalization can damage soft template alignment; regrade every intent claim afterwards.
capabilities.exercise: Q6: concave board, hole, courtyard missing, custom pad, opposite-side part and locked shield.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Final footprint/body/courtyard/hole/outline geometry, no illegal pad clearance, no wrong-side keepout, template/proximity still valid.

capabilities.entrypoints: intent decaps.max_distance_mm / max_pin_distance_mm; proximity[] pads; place_simple.py
capabilities.semantics: Decaps prefer supply-pin sites on ICs in their group, distributing sites; error-graded decap bounds contribute penalties. Proximity can bind to specific pads for feedback, filters, clocks and protection.
capabilities.limitations: Automatically inferred owner is a heuristic; power connectivity alone does not identify the correct loop. Penalty minimization is not hard satisfaction, and post-fanout moves may violate limits with disclosure.
capabilities.exercise: Q2: shared rail with two ICs, multiple supply pins, clock and ESD adjacency; move one cap beyond authored pin limit.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Pin-edge distance per claim on final board, owner source and counts; negative must fail even if route and DRC pass.

capabilities.entrypoints: py_tools/fit_template.py; intent templates[]; place_simple.py
capabilities.semantics: Fit member poses/pad relationships to anchor templates; annealing carries templates. Template measurements and ground-return rows expose deviations.
capabilities.limitations: Template grade is normally warning; final legalizer may displace members. Return geometry is graded rather than fully priced; generic engineering proof of switch-loop inductance is absent.
capabilities.exercise: Q2: authored regulator layout template and decap return relationship, constrained collision forcing legalization.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Final pad-relative position/angle, loop and return bounds, no warning treated as satisfied required template.

capabilities.entrypoints: place_pose.py replicate --from INSTANCE --to INSTANCE --intent intent.json; check_floorplan.py --suggest-arrays; intent arrays/replicate/blocks.rotation
capabilities.semantics: Dedicated replication maps repeated sheet circuitry and grades member offsets; array formation and declared rotations have independent floorplan checks.
capabilities.limitations: place_simple does not consume arrays, replicate, keep_away or block rotation/candidate-angle claims as a complete optimizer. Separate application and final grade are required. Availability of a grader is not automated constraint satisfaction.
capabilities.exercise: Q6: two replicated channels and ordered connector/LED array; intentionally misrotate one member.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Correspondence maps, offsets, rotation candidates, array pitch/order, unmatched reference rejection.

capabilities.entrypoints: py_placer/judge_seeds.py RUN/judge.json --chain CHAIN.txt --intent intent.json --jobs 1
capabilities.semantics: Fresh isolated directory per placement, shlex command chain with in/out/dir/seed/run placeholders, quick route and quick_score. Placement legality/floorplan/assembly precede routing cost; route gaps, vias, copper then segments rank candidates.
capabilities.limitations: Nonzero chain step can continue when output exists. Exit 0 means every candidate scored, not clean routing. Quick 2 omits expensive recovery/plane completion; full route must start from selected placement. Even all-bad candidates can be ranked.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q2: matched twelve seeds, six shortlisted, one deliberately unroutable placement; final full-route selected seed.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Selection based on actual emitted board, failed seed retained; full non-quick native route/checks determine acceptance, not winning score.

capabilities.entrypoints: route_review.py BOARD --json REVIEW; converge.py where/record/verdict; check_reachability.py BOARD
capabilities.semantics: Reports open/costly nets, congestion cells, useful two-pad half-turns; reachability identifies constrained channels; convergence ledger binds scores to board hashes and detects incompatible/ungraded evidence.
capabilities.limitations: This is operator/agent-guided iteration, not a single closed-loop circuit-to-manufacturing solver. Route-review exit 0 may contain serious findings; congestion/airwire geometry remains an approximation.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q2: route failure, move implicated block with constraints, reroute; attempt to record stale score.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Failure-to-placement trace, unchanged required constraints, candidate hash validation, measurable final improvement without lost coverage.

capabilities.entrypoints: py_placer/place_fanout_clearance.py FANNED OUT --intent intent.json --max-displacement-cap 3
capabilities.semantics: Moves two-pad C/R/FB passives near BGAs, permits quarter-turns, grows move budget, optionally nudges a via, then reconnects copper and regrades actual final state. Run once after all fanouts.
capabilities.limitations: Only decap limits and declared rotations from intent are consumed; other floorplan constraints are not held. An otherwise impossible repair may break a decap limit and report it. Its --clearance means class ceiling and changes project rules; omission still invokes floor/severity provenance writer.
capabilities.exercise: Q3: initial cap-via conflict and constrained cap; move under-BGA passive then route.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Before/final violation counts, all moved poses, rerouted cap nets, final full floorplan grade and original rules unchanged or explicitly authorized changes.

capabilities.feature: Native PCB parsing and write preservation
capabilities.entrypoints: route.py BOARD OUT; copy_board.py IN OUT
capabilities.semantics: Reads native nets, pads, geometry, rules, stackup and writes copper while carrying sibling project/declarations. Writer and in-memory cleanup track explicit strip/add lists.
capabilities.limitations: Custom parser and pcbnew are distinct semantic models; unsupported rule/copper coverage must be tested. Native KiCad remains authority. Board edits do not automatically prove schematic/BOM identity.
capabilities.exercise: All Q cases: compare input/output native identities, unknown properties, custom pads, arcs, locked copper and project siblings.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Native reload, pin/net maps, UUID/footprint preservation, locked geometry, rule and sibling hashes; reject unmodelled material semantics.

capabilities.feature: Octilinear multilayer grid routing and vias
capabilities.entrypoints: route.py BOARD OUT --layers F.Cu In1.Cu In2.Cu B.Cu --grid-step 0.1 --layer-costs 1 -1 -1 3
capabilities.semantics: Rust GridRouter A* over grid/layers with via, turn, proximity and preferred-direction costs; forbidden layers still obstruct and span through vias. Single-ended two- and multi-terminal nets route through native geometry.
capabilities.limitations: Generated vias are through vias; existing blind/buried spans can be modelled but advanced HDI synthesis is not established. Weighted heuristics/grid resolution do not guarantee optimal copper or exact continuous-space routability.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q4: route across obstacles with top/bottom and four-layer variants; forbid inner signal copper.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Zero unconnected, allowed layers, exact via drill/span/clearance, track widths, per-layer copper length and via count.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py --ordering mps|inside_out|original|bus --nets PATTERNS; --component REFS; --group NAME --group-by SOURCES --group-scope SCOPE
capabilities.semantics: Maximum-planar-subset crossing analysis, inside-out package routing, original order and bus-first choices; exact/glob net/component/block scope and multipoint main/tap scheduling.
capabilities.limitations: Scope semantics matter: touching a block can select a board-wide net. --component excludes rails by default. Finite ordering heuristics do not guarantee completion; test automatic plane-net inclusion explicitly.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q4: exact net names including punctuation, two orders, block-local vs touching scope.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Declared/actual net roster, no unintended deletion or skipped required rail; order/event log and measured final coverage.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py --keepout --keepout-layer User.2; native rule areas; .kicad_dru; --net-clearances MAP.json
capabilities.semantics: Exact segment capsules and via/pad geometry build grid obstacles; board outline/cutouts, NPTH holes, same-net paste restrictions, class pair clearance and supported layer rules. User polygons and net-filtered native disallow rules constrain routes.
capabilities.limitations: Only a supported subset of KiCad custom rule language is interpreted; unsupported rules must remain in native final DRC. Explicit --net-clearances replaces auto map; omitted names fall back to base. Raster search still needs exact output checks.
capabilities.exercise: Q4,Q6: slot, curved outline, custom pad, locked foreign copper, per-layer rule, net-filtered keepout and intentionally unsupported rule.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Native DRC at original severities; rule applicability roster; no wrong-layer copper/holes; no silent loss of explicit per-net constraints.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py --guide-corridor --guide-corridor-layer User.1 --keep-away ...; sibling design brief keep_away
capabilities.semantics: Soft guide attraction, track/stub/BGA proximity costs and declared aggressor/victim separation influence search; hard polygons remain separate obstacles.
capabilities.limitations: Guides are preferences, not guaranteed waypoints or hard spacing. Placement keep_away is graded but not priced by place_simple. Use explicit final minimum separation checks for required EMC relationships.
capabilities.exercise: Q2,Q4: sensitive clock beside switch node; preferred corridor blocked in one variant.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Final aggressor/victim gap and shared length; hard rule failures reject even when guide preference improved.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py --max-ripup 3 --ripup-blocker-select count --ripup-abandon-metric stranded; --rip-existing-nets PATTERNS
capabilities.semantics: Failure frontiers attribute blockers; progressively rip combinations, retry failed connection and restore victims. Strategies include count, target distance, bidirectional, mincut and route-cost weighting; history avoids unchanged retries.
capabilities.limitations: Automatic existing-copper authority is limited to small unprotected non-zone routes; explicit exact names can override some protection, never KiCad locks or protected sense branch. A victim restored as full_open/stub is not electrically restored.
capabilities.exercise: Q4: deliberately blocked route with one permitted victim, locked victim and coupled pair victim.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Blocker evidence, finite attempt/budget log, before/final connected components for every victim, locked copper unchanged; failure remains failure.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py full run; --quick 1|2 excludes subsets; escalation policy controls smaller geometry
capabilities.semantics: Fine-grid net_rescue, terminal escape, selective stub/layer moves and later whole-net reconciliation retry unresolved components; native oracle links and plane finalization add later repair passes.
capabilities.limitations: Default rescue may reduce widths/clearances and move a passive. Budgets apply to different stages; exact final config must be recorded. --quick outputs are probes, not completed boards.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q3,Q4: failed coarse-grid connection and timeout/interruption variant.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Per-stage attempts and delivered minima; all original requirements regraded; partial/cancelled result cannot pass acceptance.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py/route_diff.py --no-stub-layer-swap (disable); --can-swap-to-top-layer; --mps-layer-swap
capabilities.semantics: Upfront and rescue switches exchange or relocate stubs onto common routable layers; multi-terminal stubs can collapse to one layer. Adds pad vias only when geometry permits.
capabilities.limitations: Enabled by default; alters existing unlocked stubs. Same-net-pad policy, all physical stack layers and forbidden-layer costs must survive every switch. Keep-input-copper only protects cleanup, not all transformations.
capabilities.exercise: Q3,Q4: stubs on different layers, omitted inner layer, forbidden target layer, locked stub.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Via count plus final native connectivity, no forbidden copper, original protected geometry intact; explicit opt-out reaches every rescue.

capabilities.feature: Permitted pin/target swaps and schematic sync
capabilities.entrypoints: route.py/route_diff.py --swappable-nets PATTERNS --schematic-dir DIR; route_diff.py --polarity-swap-nets PATTERNS
capabilities.semantics: Hungarian assignment minimizes target distance/layer/crossing costs for permitted nets; polarity swap is opt-in. Board net/pad changes can be propagated into native schematic symbol pin assignments.
capabilities.limitations: Only electrically interchangeable pins may be authorized. Schematics are searched non-recursively; repeated instances/multi-unit/shared definitions need verification. Swapping without successful schematic sync breaks design identity.
capabilities.exercise: Q4: explicitly swappable FPGA GPIO pair and non-swappable USB pair; repeated schematic instance negative.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Exact allowed permutation, schematic-to-PCB exported-netlist equality, firmware pinmap evidence where applicable, denied swap reported, no pad-net mutation outside scope.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py/route_diff.py --keep-input-copper; smoothing controls; KICAD_BOARD_LEDGER=1 audit
capabilities.semantics: Shared pipeline snaps gaps, removes phantom/orphan/dead copper, prunes redundant cycles, repairs grazes, necks near pads, smooths/merges and closes soft joints. Protected length/impedance/pair geometry is excluded from selected smoothing.
capabilities.limitations: Default cleanup may remove input copper in scope. --keep-input-copper is a cleanup contract, not complete route immutability; root-owned wrapper also locks existing copper. Every strip/write must match final native geometry.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q4: good hand route, unused stub, redundant loop, deliberate soft joint, unmatched arc and meander.
capabilities.required_output_checks: No lost required geometry, final components, no orphan/dangling copper or fragile joints, preservation signatures and full native DRC.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py normal finalize; repair_planes.py default oracle; py_tools/kicad_unconnected.py BOARD
capabilities.semantics: Reads exact missing links from kicad-cli after refill, attempts geometric welds, then regrades. After late reconciliation, verifies previously complete pours again and can restore earlier copper when pours lost exceed gains.
capabilities.limitations: kicad_unconnected extracts only unconnected_items, not all native DRC violations. Missing native tooling can leave partial model-only paths; acceptance must require actual native reports. Placement/pad mutations cannot be undone by copper-only restore.
capabilities.exercise: Q5: narrow pour neck cut by late signal; model-connected/native-open defect.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Native report bound to final board and original rules, all missing links zero, all DRC checks separately inspected, re-audit verdict and restore identity retained.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py --power-nets VCC ... --power-nets-widths 0.8 ...; omit --track-width to use net-class widths
capabilities.semantics: Pattern-mapped power widths route trunks/taps at wider geometry; widths are at least run base width. Existing netclasses/custom width rules supply per-net geometry when not explicitly overridden.
capabilities.limitations: Name and width counts/order matter. A width setting is not current/temperature/drop proof; narrow fallback must be checked against engineering requirements.
capabilities.exercise: Q2,Q5: current-bearing rail and signal share obstacles; declare minimum copper widths from calculations.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Minimum width and neck extent by net, worst-case voltage drop/current/temperature margins, native width rule; no silent base-width rail fallback.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py --neckdown-length 2.5 --neckdown-taper-length 0.5 --no-power-tap-neckdown; --escalation off
capabilities.semantics: Widens where exact geometry fits, tap/main retries can fall back toward base width, pad-entry widths fit short pad dimension and taper in steps. Under escalation off only tightly bounded short pad-entry necks remain allowed.
capabilities.limitations: Off is not literally zero necks: source allows short pad-entry connections up to 2 mm. Power/impedance compliance requires segment-level geometry and maximum allowed neck length, not just nominal width.
capabilities.exercise: Q5: wide rail entering fine-pitch pin, narrow neck allowed/forbidden variants.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Actual neck width/length/location, pad-local exception boundary, unchanged rule floors, reject consequential overlong narrow power segment.

capabilities.entrypoints: route_planes.py BOARD OUT --nets GND VCC --plane-layers In1.Cu In2.Cu; --skip-existing-zones
capabilities.semantics: Creates zones, classifies pads and thermal arrays. Same-net same-layer pours are replaced by run settings by default; preservation flag retains them. Other-net zones coexist with priority handling.
capabilities.limitations: Pour stage performs no pad tapping or signal routing; disconnected pad counts are expected. Final route must include every plane net. Replacement can change zone outlines/thermal settings; preserve authored zones explicitly.
capabilities.exercise: Q5: pre-authored irregular pour and new plane; replacement/preserve variants.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Zone definitions, priorities, layers, clearances and thermal policy; final refill connectivity after routing; no unexpected authored pour replacement.

capabilities.feature: Multiple nets sharing a plane layer
capabilities.entrypoints: route_planes.py BOARD OUT --nets "AGND|DGND" --plane-layers In1.Cu
capabilities.semantics: Builds net spines and clipped Voronoi partition zones; seed points come from existing pads/vias, virtual drops or projected outer pads when the layer is virgin.
capabilities.limitations: Partition is geometrical rather than a deliberate return-current design. Virtual/projected seeds are not fabricated vias. Split domains still need explicit tie and return checks.
capabilities.exercise: Q5: virgin inner split plane with analog/digital placement, narrow bottleneck and declared star tie.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Each net has correct isolated polygon, no unintended bridge, all pads eventually connected, reference-plane continuity on relevant signals.

capabilities.entrypoints: repair_planes.py BOARD OUT --rip-blocker-nets; normally route.py in-run finalize
capabilities.semantics: Fill-model/raster components plus cross-layer barrels identify split regions; MST selects joins, multi-source bidirectional A* routes wide-to-narrow straps, open-space anchors add vias. Repairs pads and restores ripped victims.
capabilities.limitations: Coarse fill models can disagree with KiCad; oracle required. Incomplete-pads status may exit 0; rip casualties exit 4. Explicit repair parameters needed outside normal chain; deleted bare islands and kept copper islands have different significance.
capabilities.exercise: Q5: split retained island on secondary layer, isolated SMD pad, recoverable blocker and irreparable island.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Refilled native per-net connected components, all victim nets restored, region area/strap width, unconnected_pads status and exact failure signal.

capabilities.feature: Thermal via arrays and via-in-pad policy
capabilities.entrypoints: route_planes.py --thermal-vias / --no-thermal-vias; --same-net-pad-clearance VALUE
capabilities.semantics: Exposed/thermal SMD pads on active parts at least 2 mm on both axes receive lattice via arrays; missing fit defers to route. Positive same-net-pad clearance propagates via-in-pad/paste exclusion across chain.
capabilities.limitations: Thermal array heuristics are not thermal simulation. Manufacturing treatment of via-in-pad, filled/capped declarations and supplier capability must be independently validated; default may permit via-in-pad.
capabilities.exercise: Q2,Q5: QFN exposed pad, large connector pad that must not get array, forbidden paste opening.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Via count/spacing/drill/annulus and pad mapping, thermal model, plating/capping profile, final paste-opening violations.

capabilities.entrypoints: route_planes.py --stitch-vias --stitch-pitch 5 --stitch-edge-fence; optional --stitch-max-freq MHz
capabilities.semantics: Stitches nets owning at least two poured layers; sites require main-component fill, ring margin, obstacle/drill clearance and pcbnew fill confirmation when available. Fence samples real outer outlines; frequency option uses wavelength/20.
capabilities.limitations: Without pcbnew/source, model-only gate may continue. Interior cutouts are not fenced. Lattice coverage and wavelength estimate are not EMC certification.
capabilities.exercise: Q5: two GND layers, concave outer outline and cutout, false isolated fill island.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Native same-net bond to two actual pours, maximum uncovered spacing, fence distance, no duplicate/isolated vias and explicit cutout coverage limitation.

capabilities.entrypoints: route_planes.py --add-gnd-vias --gnd-via-distance 2; route_diff.py default return vias; optional --gnd-via-net
capabilities.semantics: Single-ended return pass searches outward around signal vias. Ground domains derive from endpoint parts; two-pad ties excluded from seeding. Differential route reserves then exact-checks/nudges return-via sites.
capabilities.limitations: Ambiguous domains fall back board-wide; explicit override can choose wrong return domain. Differential sites can be skipped when no legal location, with gnd_vias_not_placed report. This is not complete return-path analysis.
capabilities.exercise: Q4,Q5: AGND/DGND tie, signal transitions in each domain, crowded pair via and ambiguous endpoint domain.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Actual return net, distance and two-layer plane bonds, skipped-site roster, no domain short, reference continuity independently graded.

capabilities.entrypoints: Native KiCad copper group named sense:REF.PAD, read by route/route_diff/planes without CLI flag
capabilities.semantics: Valid pre-authored branch copper and sense pads become foreign to same-net route except join pad; held copper immutable and whole-net stripping refused. Reports invalid or poured-over branches and final taps.
capabilities.limitations: Does not synthesize a Kelvin branch from intent. Invalid preexisting branch is reported unprotected; native DRC does not detect same-net topology errors. Required branch validation must fail closed.
capabilities.exercise: Q5: shunt sense branch plus power load, illegally tapped branch and pour crossing it.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Only star join connects load to sense path, group/member identities preserved, final topology error rejected even with DRC clean.

capabilities.entrypoints: route_planes.py plane_resistance summary; analyze_power_paths.py BOARD classifies roles; Python API trace_power_paths/get_power_net_recommendations completes analysis
capabilities.semantics: Reports approximate R=rho L/(W t), width/path estimates and chart-fit current estimates using board copper stackup. Out-of-chart plane current values are labelled not rated.
capabilities.limitations: Diagonal/MST path and averaged widths are approximations, not worst-case field/thermal solutions. IPC-2152-labelled correction is an upstream estimator, not supplier qualification. Component/current assumptions still required.
capabilities.exercise: Q2,Q5: compare retained calculations with independently bounded rail/drop/load analysis.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Document source/load/current assumptions, minimum bottleneck widths, temperature and voltage margins; never use chart extrapolation as a rated current.

capabilities.entrypoints: route_diff.py BOARD OUT --nets PATTERNS --layers ALL_COPPER
capabilities.semantics: Suffix-aware P/N detection handles USB, indexed, polarity and KiCad auto names; nearest terminal pairs on same layer feed route. Bare pads derive escape direction from package and alternate launch sides.
capabilities.limitations: Must match electrical pair identity, not names alone. Defaults list only F.Cu/B.Cu; escaped inner-layer terminals require explicit layers. Short pairs may defer to single-ended under source threshold assumptions.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q4: native USB pair, indexed lanes, confusing mixed suffix and inner fanout terminal.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Required pair roster, correct polarity and endpoints, every deferred/skipped pair accounted for; no required pair silently routed single-ended.

capabilities.entrypoints: route_diff.py --diff-pair-gap G --min-turning-radius R --max-setback-angle A --max-turn-angle A
capabilities.semantics: Rust pose A* over x/y/heading/layer uses Dubins heuristic and setback distance/angle ladder; centerline offsets maintain layer pitch, miter corners, paired vias and approach/exit constraints.
capabilities.limitations: Fixed layer pitch, grid snapping and heuristic search; output can neck near obstacles. Every pair requires actual coupled length, gap, skew and topology checks, not success count.
capabilities.exercise: Q4: facing, orthogonal, reversed bare-pad launches with obstacle and required layer change.
capabilities.required_output_checks: P/N no crossing, polarity, per-layer width/gap, skew, uncoupled extent, matched vias and returns, native pair rules.

capabilities.entrypoints: route_diff.py normal fallback; --no-stub-layer-swap controls terminal switches
capabilities.semantics: Three-plus terminal pairs form a chain, at most two legs per terminal. Last-resort hybrid routes coupled middle and single-ended terminal legs, tries order/polarity, rejects plans bypassing coupled middle and re-asks seams.
capabilities.limitations: Terminals cannot be mid-track taps. Hybrid connectivity alone does not imply sufficient coupling. Some short/blocked pair paths defer to SE; measure final uncoupled/skew rules explicitly.
capabilities.exercise: Q3,Q4: QFN crowded source, connector-resistor-IC chain and polarity mismatch with swap prohibited.
capabilities.required_output_checks: All pair terminals connected in intended topology, coupled middle on actual signal path, acceptable uncoupled legs/skew, no undeclared pin swap.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py --impedance 50; route_diff.py --impedance 100 --diff-pair-gap G; --coplanar-gap G
capabilities.semantics: Uses native dielectric/copper stackup with microstrip, symmetric/asymmetric stripline, differential and grounded-coplanar formula/inverse solvers; selects per-layer widths and persists declaration.
capabilities.limitations: Analytic approximations, not EM field solver or supplier impedance guarantee. Missing dielectric can produce applied:false; mixed pair layer rules/specs may require separate invocations. Fixed explicit widths/fab floors can make target unachievable.
capabilities.exercise: Q4: approved four-layer stackup, 50-ohm line/100-ohm pair/coplanar line; missing stackup negative.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Every required net/layer solved and achieved within allowed tolerance, applied true, actual necks and coplanar gaps; independent calculator/profile review.

capabilities.entrypoints: py_tools/check_impedance.py BOARD --nets PATTERNS --json REPORT
capabilities.semantics: Samples actual copper for coplanar side-gap and adjacent reference fill voids/domain splits; default sample step 0.15 mm and minimum void length 0.30 mm. Reports declaration mismatch and impedance estimates.
capabilities.limitations: Diagnostic sampling/fill model has finite resolution; no end-to-end SI or EMC proof. Target spec with applied:false must be required elsewhere. Exit behavior and missing data must be inspected, not just zero crossings.
capabilities.exercise: Q4,Q5: routed trace across narrow reference slot, wrong-domain plane and mismatched coplanar gap.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Per-net/layer coverage, all declared impedance targets measured, detection of slot/domain split, retained actual/correct reference layer.

capabilities.feature: Length matching and absolute length windows
capabilities.entrypoints: route.py/route_diff.py --length-match-group PATTERNS --length-match-tolerance 0.1 --meander-amplitude A --meander-spacing S
capabilities.semantics: Shorter nets gain clearance-checked trombone meanders on suitable straight segments, iterating amplitude and sites. Group auto-detection covers DDR2-5/LPDDR4-5 byte lanes and command/address grouping; optional pad-to-die lengths.
capabilities.limitations: Space can be insufficient; warnings/tolerance failures remain. Absolute .kicad_dru length windows are graded, not synthesized. Through-via barrel model can differ from native used-span grading.
capabilities.exercise: Q4: deliberately unequal bus lengths, constrained meander corridor, absolute minimum length and package-delay data.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Final native path lengths and full required group membership, skew tolerance, absolute windows, no loops/stubs used to inflate useful path length.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py/route_diff.py --time-matching --time-match-tolerance PS --length-match-group PATTERNS
capabilities.semantics: Matches estimated propagation delay using per-layer effective dielectric and via barrel contributions, allowing different physical lengths across layers.
capabilities.limitations: Simplified effective-epsilon model; missing stackup falls back and can reduce to length ordering. Not waveform timing simulation. Package/driver/load data require separate proof.
capabilities.exercise: Q4: same logical bus on microstrip and stripline plus declared pad-to-die differences.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Delay calculation inputs, per-layer/native path and barrel lengths, final delay skew tolerance, missing dielectric fails required check.

capabilities.entrypoints: route_diff.py --diff-pair-intra-match --ac-couple-match; repeatable --length-match-group
capabilities.semantics: Intra-pair meanders and regrade address P/N skew; AC-coupled topology composes paths through series capacitors for total-length matching.
capabilities.limitations: AC matching runs after groups and may perturb them; do not double-include composed nets without final recheck. Pair protection records must survive later routes and cleanup.
capabilities.exercise: Q4: asymmetric pair plus two AC coupling capacitors; route unrelated net afterwards.
capabilities.required_output_checks: End-to-end composed length/skew and coupling after final pass, capacitor endpoints correct, no later cleanup destroys meanders.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py --bus; --ordering bus; --bus-detection-radius R --bus-attraction-radius R
capabilities.semantics: Geometric endpoint clique/group filtering and inflated-width corridor probes; middle-out member order and direction-aligned attraction, across-layer reduced bonus; multipoint taps deferred.
capabilities.limitations: --ordering bus alone only orders. route_diff accepts bus flags but ignores them for coupled pairs. Geometric bus grouping is not electrical bus identity and supplies no timing/coupling guarantee. Experimental awx route_bus is separate.
capabilities.exercise: Q4: 8-bit bus with one unrelated near-parallel net and one multi-terminal lane; constrained layer crossing.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Correct intended bus membership, no omitted lane, final completion, copper/vias, timing separately, no added meander/cost exploitation.

capabilities.entrypoints: Automatic protected_nets, impedance_specs, same_net_pad_clearance and pour_served_pads project records
capabilities.semantics: Matched nets, coupled pairs, impedance declarations and pour commitments inform later routing/protection; exact-name rip can override some protection but locks/sense branches remain held.
capabilities.limitations: In route.py CLI the protection/impedance persistence calls sit inside the not no_fix_drc_settings block. Preserving authored rules by that flag can skip these record writes in this path; wrapper must preserve commitments separately and test replay.
capabilities.exercise: Q4,Q5: route matched group, copy project, route another net under no-fix policy and replay.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Commitments retained with correct identity while original engineering rules unchanged; no stale/latest-record collision or loss.

capabilities.entrypoints: bga_fanout.py BOARD -c REF -o OUT --layers ALL --diff-pairs PATTERNS --escape-method channel
capabilities.semantics: Grid inference, adjacent same-net joins, channels/45-degree stubs and layer assignment; coupled pair escapes; NC/single-pad nets skipped. Rotation and back-face transforms use local frame then map copper back.
capabilities.limitations: Requires feasible pitch/via/track/clearance. Staggered no-lead arrays refused in favor of QFN underpad. Documentation states BGA escapes use one --clearance rather than per-netclass map; verify heterogeneous classes natively.
capabilities.exercise: Q3: glasgow_revC and rotated/mirrored copies, with pair/rail selections and different net classes.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Every required ball reaches routable stub, pair polarity/layer/pitch, no false NC skip, exact transformed pad joins and native clearances.

capabilities.feature: Dense underpad and dogbone BGA fanout
capabilities.entrypoints: bga_fanout.py --escape-method auto|underpad|dogbone --same-net-pad-clearance VALUE
capabilities.semantics: Auto compares channel with underpad when balls drop. Deepest-first signal ball drops escape on inner layers; dogbone uses validated diagonal inter-ball sites with via-in-pad fallback when permitted; pair escapes can be coupled.
capabilities.limitations: Some pair escapes fall back SE. Dogbone fallback requires manufacturing authorization for via-in-pad. Full array routing and all pair couplings are not guaranteed by escaped-ball count.
capabilities.exercise: Q3: dense ulx3s subset or small native dense-array qualification design, one no-free-gap ball, explicit no-via-in-pad.
capabilities.required_output_checks: All required balls, no prohibited pad/paste overlap, matching copper span, per-pair coupling/deferred roster, final full routing, drill/annulus profile.

capabilities.feature: BGA plane drops and pour promises
capabilities.entrypoints: bga_fanout.py --plane-drop auto --plane-net-layers NET:LAYER,...
capabilities.semantics: Excluded plane-net balls get gap via or permitted on-pad fallback, or short fill contact if predicted/main pour serves ball. Promises are persisted and audited after route finalization.
capabilities.limitations: Future pour projections are promises, not connectivity. Detached promise welding is env opt-in KICAD_POUR_PROMISE_WELD=1; otherwise detached balls are named but may remain. Required acceptance must reject any unserved promised ball.
capabilities.exercise: Q3,Q5: pour-served BGA rail ball whose fill is cut by later signal.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Every promised ball verified against final KiCad fill, no stale ref/net/layer promises; explicit detached counts block acceptance.

capabilities.entrypoints: qfn_fanout.py BOARD -c REF -o OUT --escape-method stub|underpad; --allow-via-in-pad
capabilities.semantics: Footprint-local pad axis determines escapes at any rotation/face; straight plus 45-degree fan, neighbour gap sharing, same-net-pad termination and staggered underpad via search; alternative orders rescue dropped legs.
capabilities.limitations: Single-line parts refused; default can escalate clearance per pad. --allow-via-in-pad also expands inward offset reach beyond pad, so name is narrower than behavior; positive same-net-pad clearance still forbids overlapping own pad.
capabilities.exercise: Q3: qfn_csi_underpad_diff and two close QFNs, both fanout orders, rotated/back variant.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Required pin escape count and exact end contact, no long dangling tails, clearance/drill profile, order sensitivity measured and every escalated pin disclosed.

capabilities.entrypoints: route.py normal rescue; KICAD_RESCUE_CAP_MOVE=0 disables the default-enabled scoped rescue move
capabilities.semantics: A bare-ball rescue can queue a verified movable passive relocation where its escape via lands; writes move only for shipped via, updates model/native board and rewelds cap nets.
capabilities.limitations: Routing is not purely copper-only. Whole placement intent must be independently regraded; the scoped rescue is not a complete general floorplan constraint engine. Manufacturing placement files must be generated afterwards.
capabilities.exercise: Q3: BGA escape blocked by movable passive and same situation with owner-fixed passive.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Moved-part roster and reasons, fixed pose unchanged, all final block/pin/side rules, rewelded nets, BOM/CPL reflects final coordinates.

capabilities.entrypoints: KICAD_TAP_RELOCATION=1 route.py; KICAD_TAP_RELOCATION_MAX defaults 2
capabilities.semantics: Opt-in removal of one zone-backed preexisting tap via plus short stub permits blocked route; recomputes per-net obstacle cache and delegates lost connection to plane finalization.
capabilities.limitations: Depends on later repair reclaiming connectivity; zone presence is not proof repair succeeds. This differs from broad rip permission and needs explicit preserved geometry policy.
capabilities.exercise: Q5: signal blocked by a single plane tap, with permitted and locked tap variants.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Exact removed copper, no obstacle-cache underflow, tap restored/replaced and final plane connectivity, locked geometry untouched.

capabilities.entrypoints: py_router/check_drc.py BOARD; check_connected.py BOARD; check_pads.py BOARD
capabilities.semantics: Source geometry checker covers segment/via/pad clearances, widths, holes, edges, selected pair/length rules and soft joints; connectivity graph grades components; pad checker catches model/geometry overlaps.
capabilities.limitations: These are KRT instruments, not full native KiCad DRC/ERC. Their finite model, tolerance and rule coverage must be explicit; use original native project for acceptance.
capabilities.exercise: All Q cases plus missing segment and wrong-net short negatives.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Individual defect records and rule coverage; native ERC/DRC after saved reload/refill must also pass at authored severities.

capabilities.entrypoints: check_floorplan.py BOARD --intent intent.json --require-rules RULES; check_assembly.py BOARD --baseline INPUT --intent intent.json
capabilities.semantics: Rule roster tracks applicability/abstention; pin/side/edge/proximity/template/array/placement checks. Assembly grades pad/body/courtyard/hole/edge/testpoint and connector mating relationships with authored waivers.
capabilities.limitations: Several courtyard/body findings gate only when moved vs baseline or explicitly declared; unrequested rules may abstain; default template/keep-away severity may warn. Baseline-relative cleanliness is insufficient for required absolute placement constraints.
capabilities.exercise: Q2,Q6: violate each declared constraint with clean routing; omit required rule/intent; stale board report.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Every mandatory rule ran freshly and passed final artifact, all memberships/sides/distances reported; no baseline exception hides required absolute defect.

capabilities.entrypoints: check_orphan_stubs.py; check_weird.py; check_cycles.py; check_orthonormal.py; net_forensics.py; check_join.py
capabilities.semantics: Diagnoses dangling copper/vias, weird geometry, cycles, non-octilinear segments, net topology and staged hand-join collisions/transitions. Emits actionable net/coordinate records.
capabilities.limitations: Different tools have different exit contracts; check_join invokes KRT DRC rather than full native DRC. Non-octilinear copper may be intentionally valid. Findings need scoped interpretation without weakening mandatory rules.
capabilities.exercise: Q4: append dangling via/stub, duplicate loop and layer transition without via.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Specific introduced defect detected on final native board, no false completion from zero-return informational tool; preserve intentional geometry.

capabilities.entrypoints: board_score.py BOARD --intent ... --length-groups ... --impedance-nets ... --net-min-widths ...; check_complete.py BOARD --authored-from INPUT --baseline INPUT
capabilities.semantics: Composite blocking/joins-needed/quality score plus completion tool adds slow hygiene/native checks and authored-floor comparison. Requested-but-unrunnable check yields incomplete; rewritten floors can yield unsound.
capabilities.limitations: check_complete explicitly permits DONE with named UNGRADED components. board_score separates some .kicad_dru pair-clearance and via-in-paste findings as advisory. Neither is the goal acceptance predicate; mandatory coverage and full native severity are external obligations.
capabilities.exercise: All Q cases; omit required length/impedance spec, lower project floor and reuse stale report negatives.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Mandatory check roster bound to hash, no skipped/ungraded/stale pass; authored rules preserved; reject clean-at-weakened-floor result.

capabilities.entrypoints: Common --fab-tier auto|standard|advanced --escalation fab|board|off --strict-sizes --no-fix-drc-settings; optional --relax-drc-severities
capabilities.semantics: Default fab escalation can reduce geometry below authored minima; records delivered minima/escalations and updates output project floors. --strict-sizes exits 3 on delivered undersize/tier escalation. Severity relaxation is separate opt-in, not default.
capabilities.limitations: No-fix prevents that writer path but does not prove all geometry respected every original rule. Physical fab-tier floors are not owner approval. Cap-clearance tool has different flag/write semantics. Compare under identical immutable engineering rules and native grades.
capabilities.exercise: Q3,Q4: pinch impossible at original clearance, attempted narrower fallback, original severity preserved.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Original/output project and rule semantic diff, explicit delivered geometry, rejection when required minimum violated; upstream default run labelled separately.

capabilities.entrypoints: py_tools/fill_for_delivery.py ROUTED -o DELIVERED; route.py --write-fill
capabilities.semantics: Runs pcbnew zone fill on staged copy, saves without KiCad project rewrite and audits netclass names. Delivery helper failure returns nonzero; route write-fill failure can remain warning.
capabilities.limitations: Filled board is not manufacturing package validation. Fill helper audit checks netclass preservation, not every requirement or export. Output may remain copied but unfilled after some failure paths.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q2,Q5: empty stored fills, successful fill and missing pcbnew failure.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Stored-fill and refilled connectivity agree, full project/rule semantic preservation, output hash bound to final checks, failure cannot be shipped as accepted.

capabilities.entrypoints: render_placement.py BOARD --groups GROUPS --intent INTENT; route_render.py; render_nets.py; render_power.py; place_movie.py; route_movie.py
capabilities.semantics: Placement views show faces, groups, labels, legality, movement and detailed defect panels; copper/net/power views and saved/live route-event movies expose geometry and iteration history.
capabilities.limitations: Renders are explanatory artifacts, not semantic proof. Pillow absence can disable raster output without preventing routing. Top/bottom mirroring and native final-file identity need explicit validation.
capabilities.exercise: All accepted Q designs: annotated top/bottom and block table generated from exact final saved board.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Views match board hash and correct side transform; membership, side, critical distances and violations visible; geometry checks remain separate.
capabilities.dependencies: Core + Pillow; movie encoder depends selected output

capabilities.entrypoints: py_router/run_plan.py BOARD PLAN.json -o OUT --snapshot-dir DIR --timeout 7200; make_plan.py MANIFEST -o PLAN.json
capabilities.semantics: Loads real plugin PlanExecutor and wx/pcbnew controls headlessly, copies board and project, applies selected steps. Plan parsing inserts cap optimization and final plane verification route where needed.
capabilities.limitations: Runs have normalized/inserted steps, so compare actual executed plan, not authored JSON alone. No AI required for replay. Native GUI dependencies and popup stubs remain involved.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q3: recorded CLI chain vs loaded plan matched-input comparison with actual step list retained.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Same effective sizes/layers/net scope and emitted semantics, no hidden insertions omitted from budget; final native grades and per-step status.

capabilities.entrypoints: run_plan.py --steps 1,3-5 --snapshot-dir DIR --timeout SECONDS; PlanExecutor.stop
capabilities.semantics: PlanExecutor.stop requests cancellation at engine safe boundaries; run_plan offers selected-step execution and per-step PCB snapshots.
capabilities.limitations: Snapshots save PCB only with aSkipSettings=True, not per-step project/rule records. --steps is manual replay, not validated self-contained resume. headless timeout handler exits wx loop without calling executor.stop; final-save failures are logged. Wrapper must retain full stage state and prove safe stop/resume.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q3: interrupt at fanout and route stage, resume from captured native project/records under same config.
capabilities.required_output_checks: No surviving work, complete checkpoint siblings/hashes/config, no duplicated copper or stale records; resumed full native result equivalent within declared tolerance.

capabilities.entrypoints: REDO_MANIFEST / REDO_RUNDIR; make_plan.py; tests/gui_parity replay harness; tests/stress manifests
capabilities.semantics: Invocation recorder writes replay commands and timing JSONL including routing environment knobs; manifests, plan conversion and GUI/CLI parity harness provide reproducibility mechanisms.
capabilities.limitations: Recorded command is not accepted design evidence. Uncaptured dependency/library/runtime changes still affect results. Require exact source/build, input siblings, effective config and complete failure inventory.
capabilities.exercise: Every Q case: clean setup replay with recorded inputs and at least three identical fixed-seed repeats for claimed reliability.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Hashes/source/tool versions, commands/env/seed/budget, actual steps and outputs; compare mandatory pass coverage before quality or runtime.

capabilities.entrypoints: python3 build_router.py --from-source; python3 install_plugin.py; requirements.txt
capabilities.semantics: Python tooling plus Rust pyo3 extension; prebuilt release downloader normally available, source build avoids ABI drift. AST KRT_TOOL registry declares scopes/kinds. Source inventory found 107 declarations.
capabilities.limitations: VERSION and crate both 0.23.7 do not identify latest source. Prebuilt version can match while ABI differs. Declared tools include utility/experimental scopes and are not proven runnable by AST count.
capabilities.exercise: Clean isolated environment: build exact revision, query native/Rust/Python dependency versions, invoke documented entrypoint on Q1.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Installed source/build hashes, successful import/native execution, no fallback to mismatched release, full check roster executed.
capabilities.dependencies: Python >=3.9 ABI target; numpy>=1.22, scipy>=1.7, shapely>=2; Rust/C build; KiCad9/10 plugin advertised; KiCad10 required by owned wrapper

capabilities.entrypoints: Upstream /plan-pcb-placement, /plan-pcb-routing, power/high-speed/stackup advisory skills; CLI replay works without model
capabilities.semantics: Skills direct datasheet reading, functional grouping, stackup/width decisions, iteration and review around native tools.
capabilities.limitations: Skill instructions are not implemented autonomous circuit synthesis or validated requirements capture. Their defaults/heuristics must stay distinct from owner requirements. Do not invoke third-party model routes or agents without authorization.
capabilities.exercise: Q2: root-owned intent-to-manufacturing entrypoint must supply real requirements/parts/circuit/schematic before KRT-equivalent placement/routing.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Requirement-part-pin-net-check traceability, explicit assumptions vs decisions, no fixture/manual intermediate substituted for missing automation.

capabilities.entrypoints: KRT emits native routed PCB/project and delivery fill; no complete fab/assembly export entrypoint found in inspected CLI surface
capabilities.semantics: KRT provides placement/routing and geometry diagnostics usable as subsystem components. Agent-ee must supply engineering architecture, part evidence, native schematic creation, electrical validation and manufacturing package lifecycle.
capabilities.limitations: No source-confirmed KRT Gerber/drill/BOM/CPL package-binding workflow, supplier preview, procurement, bench testing or complete electrical correctness acceptance. These remain goal requirements rather than parity exclusions.
capabilities.exercise: Q2 and every accepted design: ordinary agent-ee invocation through current final package; stale export, wrong reference/population and netlist errors as negatives.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Native project and manufacturing hashes, copper/mask/silk/outline/drill layer/geometry checks, BOM/CPL refs/DNP/orientation consistency, all software obligations met; physical/supplier obligations explicitly unperformed.
capabilities.dependencies: Agent-ee native KiCad export/verification stack beyond KRT

capabilities.entrypoints: awx/route_bus.py BOARD OUT --src U1 --dest U2 --rounds R --json-out SUMMARY; --bus SRC:DEST:MODE:LAYERS; --find
capabilities.semantics: Separate research pipeline discovers shared array buses, jointly escapes ends, transforms to flow frame, plans multilayer lanes/braids and branches, routes finite rounds, restores unsuccessful lanes and protects handed-on copper. Explicit buses can include QFN row ends and multiple destinations.
capabilities.limitations: KRT_TOOL scope is empty: catalogued research actor, not normal routing door. It can strip bus copper and stamp project floors; length/skew rule rows are named but not counted in its untuned hand-on gate. Arrays/waypoints/name clashes/half pairs have explicit admission restrictions. Do not equate this with route.py --bus.
capabilities.exercise: Q4 optional bounded feature branch: small array-to-array bus with controlled layer/round budget; compare stock default bus and research path separately.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Full original native DRC including length/skew, no rule drift, required lanes restored or completed, protected input, actual scope/round budget. Research result is not normal-entrypoint parity.

capabilities.entrypoints: py_tools/validate_pcb_data.py BOARD [BOARD...]
capabilities.semantics: Loads native board via pcbnew and text parser, compares PCBData models including pads, zones, arcs and board bounds using the same GUI extraction path.
capabilities.limitations: Agreement only covers compared fields and does not prove whole KiCad semantic preservation. Required unsupported copper/rules need explicit refusal or authoritative downstream checks.
capabilities.exercise: Q3,Q6: rotated/backside/custom pads, slot and copper arcs; all accepted native projects.
capabilities.required_output_checks: No material model differences, explicit compared-field coverage, native connectivity/DRC still independently required.

capabilities.entrypoints: py_placer/beautify_labels.py BOARD OUT
capabilities.semantics: Moves/resizes reference designators to nearby readable positions while checking board/pad and label geometry; independent post-placement presentation tool.
capabilities.limitations: Not a general assembly-document or complete silkscreen fabrication gate. Final supplier mask/silk minimums and per-side assembly visibility remain package requirements.
capabilities.exercise: Q1,Q2: dense labels, back-side component and connector label near edge.
capabilities.required_output_checks: References unchanged and unique, readable orientation/size, no pad/mask/edge intrusion under selected fabrication profile.

capabilities.entrypoints: movie3d/make_movie.py; movie3d/find_models.py; movie3d/record.py
capabilities.semantics: Prototype records placement and optional routing flow, uses three.js in headless Chromium to render, ffmpeg to encode; reports missing component model paths.
capabilities.limitations: Empty registry scope and prototype label distinguish it from supported 2D routing tools. This visualizer is not a height/collision/enclosure checker and can run placement/routing as part of movie creation.
capabilities.exercise: Optional Q2 visual artifact, after accepted final native board; no claim of mechanical qualification from the movie.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Model provenance and final-board identity, no hidden design mutation; physical height/clearance measured separately.
capabilities.dependencies: Core + Node/npm pinned movie3d dependencies + Chromium + ffmpeg

capabilities.entrypoints: py_router/add_rule_area.py BOARD ...
capabilities.semantics: Writes KiCad copper keepout rule areas that supported routing/plane paths can consume as native obstacles.
capabilities.limitations: Authorship of a rule area does not prove every custom expression/layer/net scope is honored. Use native reload and final DRC, and bind it to declared intent.
capabilities.exercise: Q4,Q6: route/plane exclusion around antenna/mechanical reserve on selected layers.
capabilities.required_output_checks: Correct native keepout type, layers and polygons, no forbidden track/via/pour, unrelated legal geometry still possible.
